summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate (RIT, May 2026) with hands-on embedded firmware and hardware design experience across STM32 bare-metal, Arduino, and Jetson platforms. Skilled in C/C++ embedded control, schematic/prototype/test cycles, PCB design (EAGLE), and real-time system reliability — including brown-out detection, ACK/retry protocols, and safety cutoffs.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth, translating 3-DoF motion into HID commands via embedded C.
Produced full claims documentation and BOM; designed wearable gesture-recognition hardware with custom tap-detection and software calibration.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and embedded C/I2C/UART integration end-to-end.
Fabricated PCBs in EAGLE; managed sourcing and documentation for 10+ workshops.

experience.title: MS Capstone — Hardware Firmware Engineer (COFFIN)
bullets: Built embedded voice-controlled robotic arm with STM32 + Arduino C++ control, PWM servo drive, UART protocol, and VL53L0X ToF integration — validated 10/10 reliability.
Implemented brown-out reset detection, 3-retry ACK protocol (400 ms timeout), crash-safe logging, and deployed as systemd service with static IP networking.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 embedded C firmware with timer-triggered ADC scans, interrupt-driven I2C display driver, and real-time 1 Hz temperature monitoring at 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM.
Programmed peripherals directly (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1) in bare-metal C; validated in Proteus.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Integrated YOLOv8 on Jetson with STM32 servo controller over UART; implemented PWM multi-servo control and FreeRTOS mutex coordination.
Integrated VL53L0X ToF sensor with OLED distance visualization.

awards: 1st Prize — Poster Presentation (Image Mosaicing), F.C.R.I.T. 2024; 1st Prize — CanSat Workshop 2023; 10th — Robocon 2022
